stories.title: ‘SugBohol’: Bohol, Cebu seal sisterhood agreement
stories.summary:
‘SugBohol’: Bohol, Cebu seal sisterhood agreement. TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol—The provincial governments of Bohol and Cebu signed the historic SugBohol Sisterhood Agreement on Friday, July 31, forging a partnership to strengthen cooperation in governance, economic development, tourism, and public service.

The agreement was signed by Bohol Governor Erico Aristotle Aumentado and Cebu Governor Pamela Baricuatro during a ceremony at the Ceremonial Hall.
